body:
Don't include editor code in core 💀
Why do you even need this?
`resource_path` property is always a filename, so this should be unnecessary.

If anything
```suggestion
		info.path = ResourceUID.ensure_path(info.path);
```
Although FileAccess supports UIDs, so you don't need to convert it.

This is a static method.
```suggestion
		String real_path = ResourceUID::uid_to_path(scr_path);
```

I added this to clear `filesystem_cache`, if a unrecognised UID found in project. Because if you move autoload file externally and not it's UID file then it causes too much unrecognised UID errors and even if you move that uid to it's actual path still error will not solve until unless you manually delete the `filesystem_cache` in ".godot/editor/". This will automatically delete if it Recognises Unrecognised UID and fix that 😅.

Huh.
It doesn't sound like something specific to autoloads, so it can be fixed separately.

Yes, 
It's just a bug that I fixed. But if you say, I can remove it.

Should be:
```suggestion
		info.path = ResourceUID::ensure_path(info.path);
```
No?

it's necessary, if i remove this i will get this error in Godot editor:

>E 0:00:00:761   instantiate: Failed to instantiate scene state of "uid://udewa3o82q2x", node count is 0. Make sure the PackedScene resource is valid.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "nc == 0" is true. Returning: nullptr
  <C++ Source>  scene\resources\packed_scene.cpp:165 @ instantiate()

Or, i can just do `path = ResourceUID::ensure_path(path);`.

```suggestion
		info.path = ResourceUID::ensure_path(info.path);
```
That comment is unnecessary.

Although why `info.path` is a path here, but UID elsewhere?

Instead of modifying PackedScene, you should make a change in `editor_autoload_settings`:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/019889d1da32e13dfd3bea0f66f7c38ff90a6eb8/editor/settings/editor_autoload_settings.cpp#L396
I'm not sure if displaying UID is useful. It could always just show path.

`info.path` is saved in UID format in `[Autoload]` section not actual path so if we load Autoload from it then it must be converted back to path to load everything properly. And `ensure_path` is used for that, if project autoload in UID format convert it to path or if already path _(old projects migrated has path directly not UID in Autoload section)_ then leave it as is.
It is useful for better debugging,

But is also less readable.
You could put UID in the tooltip.
What exactly needs a path to load properly? The only problematic part is `reload_from_file()`, which is still handled separately.
To load a path properly we need to convert UID to actual file path in project directory. that's what it does.
ResourceLoader can load using UID.

>  scn->set_path(p_path); 

I modified this part without doing anything with `PackedScene` but Sorry, i am not able to figure out why it's still showing error when running the project, here `p_path` is actual path of autoload scene but in `get_path()` function it stills returns it's UID somehow, so i kept `ensure_path` function.
But the path we need to provide in `create_autoload` function's argument is file path not UID

What `get_path()`?
There are no errors or anything.
No, `_create_autoload()` can work with UID, you only need to ensure path in `set_path()` call.

Looks like there is more code that initializes autoloads like that:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/cb3af5afff15669a684ba4f04b9aa5c70dfd09ad/main/main.cpp#L4278
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/cb3af5afff15669a684ba4f04b9aa5c70dfd09ad/modules/gdscript/tests/gdscript_test_runner.cpp#L79
Putting `ensure_path()` there should fix it.

> What `get_path()`?

`get_path()` is a function in `packed_scene.cpp` which returns path set by `scn->set_path(info.path);` (according to my code analysis), that's why i directly edited `String path = ResourceUID::ensure_path(get_path());` in `packed_scene.cpp` this resolves all the problem that can be caused, like you said:
>Looks like there is more code that initializes autoloads like that:

Without fixing each `scn->set_path(info.path); ` in source code. it directly applies to path set from any location like: `main.cpp` and `gdscript_test_runner.cpp`.

Well, yeah, you just shouldn't use `set_path()` with UID. Patching PackedScene is a band aid for a wrong usage.
The relevant `set_path()` calls were introduced in #69079, which fixed autoload bugs. Since your PR also touches autoloads, you should update these calls.

So, what's your suggestion now? Should i use `scn->set_path(ResourceUID::ensure_path(info.path));` everywhere instead of just `String path = ResourceUID::ensure_path(get_path());` in `packed_scene.cpp`?
Yes.
Done :)
